title: River Walk water: the boat on screen 6 and the mooring piles
note: Your redraw calls on the ferry and the pile (25 Oct). The route Pepper runs on the boat (deck, cabin roof, wheelhouse roof) is 5 m long at her scale, so a commuter ferry drawn on it read as a toy. It is now a small harbour water taxi at true size on exactly those lines: nothing in the level moved. Design and colours from one SpriteCook render; every part drawn by rule in its colours: one unbroken outline, no thin railings, identical portholes and windows, a rub rail, cleats, a cabin door, a lifebuoy, the white hull shaded in three bands. An independent reviewer failed round 1 (plain hull, unequal windows, the flagstaff); all fixed. The piles are built by rule (0 credits): a dark tarred post with a rim of light on top and a rope lashing, the part that shows at the bottom of the screen. SpriteCook 24 credits.
question: The boat is a water taxi now, not a ferry (a real ferry would be about four times longer than the route). Keep the smaller boat, or change the level so a bigger ferry fits?
